record.body:
## Description

Stop inventing binary check-runs in verify-work and close_batch for tdd/check; use se-workflow check (or only CLI-produced ids). Agents still write assessments.

## Approach

1. Update `skills/verify-work/SKILL.md` so for method tdd/check the skill invokes `se-workflow check` (or accepts only runner-produced check-run ids) and does not `create` binary check-runs by hand. Manual stays human sign-off. Assessments stay in the skill.
2. Update `scripts/close_batch.py` so it does not invent pass/fail from a close-request judgment for tdd/check; it references runner-produced check-run ids (layout-only CLI migration of close_batch is out of scope).
3. Add/extend `tests/test_verify_authority.py` (and close_batch tests if needed) that fail closed if the skill or script still invents binary results. Keep `tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py` green.
4. Do not change the CLI implementation beyond what the skill docs require to name the command.
